plain_text:
M
illions of people act as long-distance caregivers,
supporting loved ones who are aging or coping with
an illness or disability. This role can include managing
a loved one's finances, organizing their medical appointments
and care, coordinating with their other caregivers, and offering
emotional support.
semantic_text: M illions of people act as long-distance caregivers, supporting loved ones who are aging or coping with an illness or disability. This role can include managing a loved one's finances, organizing their medical appointments and care, coordinating with their other caregivers, and offering emotional support.

plain_text:
Whether you are already a caregiver or may become one in the
future, these tips can help you navigate long-distance caregiving
effectively.
semantic_text: Whether you are already a caregiver or may become one in the future, these tips can help you navigate long-distance caregiving effectively.

plain_text:
Learn about your loved one's health, treatments, and living situation.
Research their health condition and available resources, including
Medicare and Medicaid benefits, and have open conversations with
them about their situation and what support they need.
semantic_text: Learn about your loved one's health, treatments, and living situation. Research their health condition and available resources, including Medicare and Medicaid benefits, and have open conversations with them about their situation and what support they need.

plain_text:
Ask your loved one for written permission to speak with their
medical team. This allows you to stay informed about their health
and care, even from a distance. Doctors and other health care
providers need this consent to share medical information with you.
semantic_text: Ask your loved one for written permission to speak with their medical team. This allows you to stay informed about their health and care, even from a distance. Doctors and other health care providers need this consent to share medical information with you.

plain_text:
Collect and organize important legal, financial, and medical
documents. Make sure they are up to date and located somewhere
secure and easy to find. Create lists of medications they take and
when they take them. Gather contact information for their doctors,
health care providers, and other important contacts, and update this
information regularly.
semantic_text:
Collect and organize important legal, financial, and medical documents. Make sure they are up to date and located somewhere secure and easy to find. Create lists of medications they take and
when they take them. Gather contact information for their doctors, health care providers, and other important contacts, and update this information regularly.

plain_text:
Schedule in-person visits with your loved one when you can. Before
you arrive, ask what your loved one would like to do during your visit,
whether it's grocery shopping, visiting friends, or household tasks.
If possible, schedule doctor's appointments during your visit (with
permission) and meet with your loved one's other caregivers if they live
close by.
semantic_text: Schedule in-person visits with your loved one when you can. Before you arrive, ask what your loved one would like to do during your visit, whether it's grocery shopping, visiting friends, or household tasks. If possible, schedule doctor's appointments during your visit (with permission) and meet with your loved one's other caregivers if they live close by.

plain_text:
Don't forget to carve out quality time together not related to caregiving.
Whether it's a shared hobby or simply relaxing and catching up,
enjoyable activities make visits less stressful. This ensures your time
together is about more than just tasks and responsibilities.
semantic_text: Don't forget to carve out quality time together not related to caregiving. Whether it's a shared hobby or simply relaxing and catching up, enjoyable activities make visits less stressful. This ensures your time together is about more than just tasks and responsibilities.

plain_text:
You can't do it all alone, especially from far away. Identify local family
members, friends, neighbors, and others who can lend a hand or help in
emergencies. Let them know what's going on and how to contact you.
semantic_text: You can't do it all alone, especially from far away. Identify local family members, friends, neighbors, and others who can lend a hand or help in emergencies. Let them know what's going on and how to contact you.

plain_text:
Build relationships with your loved one's health care providers and
other caregivers. Consider hiring local caregivers or care managers to
help coordinate care.
semantic_text: Build relationships with your loved one's health care providers and other caregivers. Consider hiring local caregivers or care managers to help coordinate care.

plain_text: Video calls can help you stay connected with family, friends, and medical providers.
semantic_text: Video calls can help you stay connected with family, friends, and medical providers.
